title: Restrictions
description: Turns device features, apps and services on or off. Unset items keep Apple's default (allowed).

allowARDRemoteManagementModification.title: Allow modifying Remote Management Sharing setting
allowARDRemoteManagementModification.description: If false, the system prevents modifying the Remote Management Sharing setting in System Settings.

allowAccountModification.title: Allow account changes
allowAccountModification.description: If false, the system disables modification of accounts, such as Apple Accounts, and internet-based accounts, such as Mail, Contacts, and Calendar.

allowActivityContinuation.title: Allow handoff
allowActivityContinuation.description: If false, the system disables activity continuation. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated. In a future release, this restriction will begin requiring supervision and will apply to personal Apple Accounts only.

allowAddingGameCenterFriends.title: Allow adding Game Center friends
allowAddingGameCenterFriends.description: If false, the system prohibits adding friends to Game Center. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

allowAirDrop.title: Allow AirDrop
allowAirDrop.description: If false, the system disables AirDrop.

allowAirPlayIncomingRequests.title: Allow incoming AirPlay requests
allowAirPlayIncomingRequests.description: If false, the system disables incoming AirPlay requests.

allowAppleIntelligenceReport.title: Allow Apple Intelligence report
allowAppleIntelligenceReport.description:
If false, the system disables Apple Intelligence reports.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowApplePersonalizedAdvertising.title: Allow Apple personalized advertising
allowApplePersonalizedAdvertising.description: If false, the system limits Apple personalized advertising.

allowAssistant.title: Allow Siri
allowAssistant.description:
If false, the system disables Siri.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.siri.settings configuration.

allowAutoUnlock.title: Allow auto unlock
allowAutoUnlock.description: If false, the system disallows auto unlock. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

allowBluetoothModification.title: Allow Bluetooth changes
allowBluetoothModification.description: If false, the system prevents modification of Bluetooth settings.

allowBluetoothSharingModification.title: Allow modifying Bluetooth sharing setting
allowBluetoothSharingModification.description: If false, the system prevents modifying Bluetooth settings in System Settings.

allowBookstore.title: Allow Book Store
allowBookstore.description: If false, the system removes the Book Store tab from the Books app.

allowBookstoreErotica.title: Allow Book Store erotica
allowBookstoreErotica.description: If false, the system prevents the user from downloading Apple Books media that's tagged as erotica. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

allowCamera.title: Allow camera
allowCamera.description: If false, the system disables the camera and removes its icon from the Home Screen, and users are unable to take photographs. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

allowCloudAddressBook.title: Allow cloud address book
allowCloudAddressBook.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Contacts services.

allowCloudBookmarks.title: Allow cloud bookmarks
allowCloudBookmarks.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Bookmark sync.

allowCloudCalendar.title: Allow cloud calendar
allowCloudCalendar.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Calendar services.

allowCloudDesktopAndDocuments.title: Allow cloud desktop and documents
allowCloudDesktopAndDocuments.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Desktop and Document services.

allowCloudDocumentSync.title: Allow iCloud Drive and document sync
allowCloudDocumentSync.description: If false, the system disables document and key-value syncing to iCloud. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later, and Shared iPad doesn't support it. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

allowCloudFreeform.title: Allow cloud freeform
allowCloudFreeform.description: If false, the system disallows iCloud Freeform services.

allowCloudKeychainSync.title: Allow iCloud Keychain
allowCloudKeychainSync.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Keychain synchronization. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

allowCloudMail.title: Allow cloud mail
allowCloudMail.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Mail services.

allowCloudNotes.title: Allow cloud notes
allowCloudNotes.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Notes services.

allowCloudPhotoLibrary.title: Allow iCloud Photos
allowCloudPhotoLibrary.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Photo Library. The system removes any photos from local storage that aren't fully downloaded from iCloud Photo Library to the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

allowCloudPrivateRelay.title: Allow cloud private relay
allowCloudPrivateRelay.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Private Relay. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices and with Managed Apple Accounts is deprecated.

allowCloudReminders.title: Allow cloud reminders
allowCloudReminders.description: If false, the system disables iCloud Reminder services.

allowContentCaching.title: Allow content caching
allowContentCaching.description: If false, the system disables content caching. This restriction is not supported on the user channel.

allowDefinitionLookup.title: Allow definition lookup
allowDefinitionLookup.description:
If false, the system disables definition lookup.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings configuration.

allowDeviceNameModification.title: Allow device name changes
allowDeviceNameModification.description: If false, the system prevents the user from changing the device name.

allowDiagnosticSubmission.title: Allow sending diagnostics to Apple
allowDiagnosticSubmission.description: If false, the system prevents the device from automatically submitting diagnostic reports to Apple.

allowDictation.title: Allow dictation
allowDictation.description:
If false, the system disallows dictation input.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.keyboard.settings configuration.

allowEraseContentAndSettings.title: Allow Erase All Content and Settings
allowEraseContentAndSettings.description: If false, the system disables the Erase All Content and Settings option in the Reset UI.

allowExplicitContent.title: Allow explicit music, podcasts and news
allowExplicitContent.description:
If false, the system hides explicit music or video content purchased from the iTunes Store. The system marks explicit content as such by content providers, such as record labels, when sold through the iTunes Store. Explicit content in the News and Podcast apps is also hidden.

Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

allowExternalIntelligenceIntegrations.title: Allow external intelligence integrations
allowExternalIntelligenceIntegrations.description:
If false, disables the use of external, cloud-based intelligence services with Siri. In iOS, this restriction is temporarily allowed on unsupervised and user enrollments. In a future release, this restriction will require supervision, and will be ignored on unsupervised devices.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.external-intelligence.settings configuration.

allowExternalIntelligenceIntegrationsSig.title: Allow external intelligence integrations sign-in
allowExternalIntelligenceIntegrationsSig.description:
If false, forces external intelligence providers into anonymous mode. If a user is already signed in to an external intelligence provider, applying this restriction signs them out when attempting the next request.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.external-intelligence.settings configuration.

allowFileSharingModification.title: Allow modifying file sharing setting
allowFileSharingModification.description: If false, the system prevents modifying File Sharing setting in System Settings.

allowFindMyDevice.title: Allow Find My Device
allowFindMyDevice.description: If false, the system disables Find My Device in the Find My app.

allowFindMyFriends.title: Allow find my friends
allowFindMyFriends.description: If false, the system disables Find My Friends in the Find My app.

allowFingerprintForUnlock.title: Allow Touch ID / Face ID unlock
allowFingerprintForUnlock.description: If false, the system prevents Touch ID, Face ID, or Optic ID from unlocking a device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

allowFingerprintModification.title: Allow Touch ID / Face ID changes
allowFingerprintModification.description: If false, the system prevents the user from modifying Touch ID or Face ID.

allowGameCenter.title: Allow Game Center
allowGameCenter.description: If false, the system disables Game Center, and the system removes its icon from the Home Screen.

allowGenmoji.title: Allow Genmoji
allowGenmoji.description:
If false, prohibits creating new Genmoji.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowImagePlayground.title: Allow Image Playground
allowImagePlayground.description:
If false, prohibits the use of image generation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowInternetSharingModification.title: Allow modifying internet sharing setting
allowInternetSharingModification.description: If false, the system prevents modifying the Internet Sharing setting in System Settings.

allowLiveVoicemail.title: Allow live voicemail
allowLiveVoicemail.description: If false, the system disables live voicemail on the device.

allowLocalUserCreation.title: Allow creating users in System Settings
allowLocalUserCreation.description: If false, the system prevents creating users in System Settings.

allowMailSmartReplies.title: Allow mail smart replies
allowMailSmartReplies.description:
If false, disables smart replies in Mail.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowMailSummary.title: Allow mail summary
allowMailSummary.description:
If false, disables the ability to create summaries of email messages manually. This doesn't affect automatic summary generation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowMediaSharingModification.title: Allow modifying Media Sharing setting
allowMediaSharingModification.description: If false, prevents modification of Media Sharing settings.

allowMultiplayerGaming.title: Allow multiplayer gaming
allowMultiplayerGaming.description: If false, the system prohibits multiplayer gaming.

allowMusicService.title: Allow Apple Music
allowMusicService.description: If false, the system disables the Music service, and the Music app reverts to classic mode.

allowNotesTranscription.title: Allow notes transcription
allowNotesTranscription.description:
If false, disables transcription in Notes.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowNotesTranscriptionSummary.title: Allow notes transcription summary
allowNotesTranscriptionSummary.description:
If false, disables transcription summarization in Notes.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowPasscodeModification.title: Allow passcode changes
allowPasscodeModification.description: If false, the system prevents adding, changing, or removing the passcode. The system ignores this restriction on Shared iPad.

allowPasswordAutoFill.title: Allow password auto fill
allowPasswordAutoFill.description:
If false, the system disables:

- The AutoFill Passwords feature in iOS, with Keychain and third-party password managers
- Prompting the user to use a saved password in Safari or in apps
- Automatic strong passwords
- Suggesting strong passwords to users

However, if false, the system doesn't prevent AutoFill for contact info and credit cards in Safari.

allowPasswordProximityRequests.title: Allow password proximity requests
allowPasswordProximityRequests.description: If false, the system disables requesting passwords from nearby devices.

allowPasswordSharing.title: Allow password sharing
allowPasswordSharing.description: If false, the system disables sharing passwords with the AirDrop passwords feature, or with the Passwords app.

allowPrinterSharingModification.title: Allow modifying Printer Sharing setting
allowPrinterSharingModification.description: If false, the system prevents modifying Printer Sharing settings in System Settings.

allowRemoteAppleEventsModification.title: Allow modifying remote Apple Events Sharing setting
allowRemoteAppleEventsModification.description: If false, the system prevents modifying Remote Apple Events Sharing settings in System Settings.

allowRemoteScreenObservation.title: Allow Classroom screen viewing
allowRemoteScreenObservation.description: If false, the system disables remote screen observation by the Classroom app. Nest this key beneath allowScreenShot as a subrestriction. If allowScreenShot is false, the Classroom app doesn't observe remote screens. Requires a supervised device until iOS 13 and macOS 10.15. Allowed for user enrollments in macOS 12 and later.

allowRosettaUsageAwareness.title: Allow rosetta usage awareness
allowRosettaUsageAwareness.description: If false, disables Rosetta usage awareness. When Rosetta usage awareness is active, the device displays a pop-up dialog to the user when launching an app that uses Rosetta. The pop-up dialog indicates that Rosetta will be removed in a future version of the operating system so that the user can contact the app vendor regarding a replacement for the current app.

allowSafariHistoryClearing.title: Allow Safari history clearing
allowSafariHistoryClearing.description: If false, the system disables the ability to clear browsing history in Safari.

allowSafariPrivateBrowsing.title: Allow Safari private browsing
allowSafariPrivateBrowsing.description: If false, the system disables the ability to use private browsing in Safari.

allowSafariSummary.title: Allow Safari summary
allowSafariSummary.description:
If false, the system disables the ability to summarize content in Safari.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowScreenShot.title: Allow screenshots and screen recording
allowScreenShot.description: If false, the system disables saving a screenshot of the display and capturing a screen recording. It also disables the Classroom app from observing remote screens.

allowSpotlightInternetResults.title: Allow Siri suggestions
allowSpotlightInternetResults.description: If false, the system disables Spotlight Internet search results in Siri Suggestions. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

allowStartupDiskModification.title: Allow modifying startup disk settings
allowStartupDiskModification.description: If false, the system prevents modification of Startup Disk settings in System Settings.

allowTimeMachineBackup.title: Allow modifying Time Machine settings
allowTimeMachineBackup.description: If false, the system prevents modification of Time Machine settings in System Settings. This restriction isn't supported on the user channel.

allowUIConfigurationProfileInstallation.title: Allow installing profiles
allowUIConfigurationProfileInstallation.description: If false, the system prohibits the user from installing configuration profiles and certificates interactively.

allowUSBRestrictedMode.title: Allow USB Restricted Mode
allowUSBRestrictedMode.description: If false, the system allows iOS devices to always connect to USB accessories while locked. In macOS, allows new USB and Thunderbolt accessories, and SD cards to connect without authorization. If the system has Lockdown mode enabled, it ignores this value. This restriction isn't supported on the user channel.

allowUniversalControl.title: Allow Universal Control
allowUniversalControl.description: If false, the system disables Universal Control.

allowWallpaperModification.title: Allow wallpaper changes
allowWallpaperModification.description: If false, the system prevents changing the wallpaper.

allowWritingTools.title: Allow writing tools
allowWritingTools.description:
If false, disables Apple Intelligence writing tools.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

allowedExternalIntelligenceWorkspaceIDs.title: Allowed external intelligence workspace IDs
allowedExternalIntelligenceWorkspaceIDs.description:
An array of strings, but currently restricted to a single element. If present, Apple Intelligence allows use of only the given external integration workspace ID, and requires a sign-in to make requests. The user is required to sign in to integrations that support signing in. Multiple payloads combine using an intersect operation. This means the allowed set of workspace IDs can become the empty set if multiple payloads specify conflicting values.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.external-intelligence.settings configuration.

allowiPhoneMirroring.title: Allow iPhone mirroring
allowiPhoneMirroring.description: If false, prohibits the use of iPhone Mirroring. In macOS, this prevents the Mac from mirroring any iPhone. In iOS, this prevents the iPhone from mirroring to any Mac.

allowiTunesFileSharing.title: Allowi tunes file sharing
allowiTunesFileSharing.description: If false, the system disables iTunes file sharing services.

enforcedFingerprintTimeout.title: Enforced fingerprint timeout
enforcedFingerprintTimeout.description: The value, in seconds, after which the fingerprint unlock requires a password to authenticate. The default value is 48 hours.

forceAssistantProfanityFilter.title: Enable Siri profanity filter
forceAssistantProfanityFilter.description:
If true, the system forces the use of the profanity filter for Siri and dictation. Requires a supervised device in iOS.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.siri.settings configuration.

forceBypassScreenCaptureAlert.title: Force bypass screen capture alert
forceBypassScreenCaptureAlert.description: If true, then the system bypasses the presentation of a screen capture alert.

forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses.title: Join Classroom classes automatically
forceClassroomAutomaticallyJoinClasses.description: If true, the system automatically gives permission to the teacher's requests without prompting the student.

forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveCl.title: Ask the teacher to leave a class
forceClassroomRequestPermissionToLeaveCl.description: If true, a student enrolled in an unmanaged course through Classroom needs to request permission from the teacher to leave the course.

forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock.title: Let Classroom lock apps without asking
forceClassroomUnpromptedAppAndDeviceLock.description: If true, the system allows the teacher to lock apps or the device without prompting the student.

forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservatio.title: Let Classroom view the screen without asking
forceClassroomUnpromptedScreenObservatio.description: If true and ScreenObservationPermissionModificationAllowed is also true in the Education payload, a student enrolled in a managed course through the Classroom app automatically gives permission to that course teacher's requests to observe the student's screen without prompting the student.

forceOnDeviceOnlyDictation.title: Force on device only dictation
forceOnDeviceOnlyDictation.description:
If true, the system disables connections to Siri servers for the purposes of dictation.

Deprecated: use the declarative management com.apple.configuration.intelligence.settings configuration.

ratingApps.title: Maximum app age rating
ratingApps.description:
The maximum level of app content allowed on the device. Starting with iOS 26.2, this rating may apply to certain system apps.

Age bands and the number of discrete age values vary by region, but the values are consistent across regions. For example, in a region that defines rating level 14+, its value is guaranteed to be larger than 300 (12+) and smaller than 600 (17+). Also, the value of rating level 15+ is guaranteed to be larger than the assigned value of rating level 14+. For more information about age ratings, see Age ratings values and definitions.

ratingMovies.title: Movies ranking number
ratingMovies.description:
The maximum level of movie content allowed on the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

Possible values, with the U.S. description of the rating level:

- 1000: All
- 500: NC-17
- 400: R
- 300: PG-13
- 200: PG
- 100: G
- 0: None

ratingRegion.title: Region code
ratingRegion.description: The two-letter key that profile tools use to display the proper ratings for the given region. The client doesn't recognize or report this data.

ratingTVShows.title: TV shows ranking number
ratingTVShows.description:
The maximum level of TV content allowed on the device. Support for this restriction on unsupervised devices is deprecated.

Possible values, with the U.S. description of the rating level:

- 1000: All
- 600: TV-MA
- 500: TV-14
- 400: TV-PG
- 300: TV-G
- 200: TV-Y7
- 100: TV-Y
- 0: None

safariAllowAutoFill.title: Allow AutoFill in Safari
safariAllowAutoFill.description:
If false, the system disables Safari AutoFill for passwords, contact info, and credit cards, and also prevents using the Keychain for AutoFill. Requires a supervised device in iOS 13 and later.

> Note:
> The system still allows third-party password managers, and apps can use AutoFill.
